profile.headline: Software Engineer by Day / Gamer by Night
profile.summary:
Innovative software engineer with 10+ years of experience working in the Intelligence Community with Top-Secret clearance. Ability to work in an agile software development, with experience in design, implementation, debugging, and testing new applications.

Software engineer by day, gamer by night.

positions.title: Cryptologic Analyst / Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked in team environment with 10+ developers
- Developed multi-component Java applications using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, and Maven
- Containerized and deployed applications on a multi-cluster Kubernetes environment via Helm & Ansible
- Extensively tested applications with unit, functional, and integration testing
- Worked alongside senior programmers and assisted them with maintaining applications
- Responded to operational calls and provided technical support to applications running 24/7
- Communicated with external customers for new features, bug fixes, and feedback
- Customized open-source code to be used for mission critical applications
- Currently hold Top Secret (TS) / Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) / Talent-Keyhole (TK) clearance
- Had Agency Special Background Investigation (SBI) and Polygraph examination for clearance (Recent: Feb. 2020)

positions.description: Assist and grade student's work based on their C++ programming projects

positions.description: Work around lighting, soundboard, computers/media equipment for special events

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked alongside senior programmers and mentors
- Maintaining and debugging Java based applications
- Learned and used new programming & database management languages
- Held Top Secret (TS) / Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) / Talent-Keyhole (TK) clearance
- Had Agency Special Background Investigation (SBI) and Polygraph examination for clearance (Apr. 2014)
